inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.inProgressHint: Sessions that are still running. Ones you flagged will remind you when they finish.
inbox.emptyBody: Approvals, plans, questions, device requests, flagged sessions that have stopped and sessions that failed show up here.
inbox.cachedHint: {{node}} is offline. This is what it last reported.
inbox.cachedBody: {{node}} is offline. This is what it last reported, so it may be out of date. You can answer once the node is back.
inbox.waitingBody: This session is waiting for approval. The request details are only available while its node is connected; open the session to answer.
inbox.noLongerWaitingBody: This item is gone from the list: it may have been handled somewhere else, ended or expired. Nothing was selected for you, so no other request can be answered by accident.
inbox.detailsArrivedBody: You had the cached placeholder selected. Nothing was opened for you: review the request first, then answer it.
inbox.outsideFilter: {{node}} is not ticked in your node filter, so this is not counted in your Inbox.
inbox.nodeOffline: {{node}} is offline. This request will show here once it is back.
inbox.nodeNeedsPairing: {{node}} no longer recognises this browser. Unlock or pair it again to see this request.
inbox.unknownNode: This request is on a node this browser has not unlocked or does not know.
inbox.laterBody: An agent added this to your to-do list. Accept it to put it on the list, or dismiss it.
inbox.laterBodyOther: This to-do was added automatically. Accept it to put it on the list, or dismiss it.
inbox.alsoError: It also ended with an error.
inbox.errorBody: This session stopped with an error. Open it to see what happened, or archive it once you have dealt with it.
inbox.enrollBody: A device wants to join {{node}}. Only approve the device in front of you.
inbox.pickOne: Select an item to see its details.
inbox.requestGone: That request has already been handled.
inbox.requestGoneBody: Nothing is pending for this session any more. It may have been answered on another device.
inbox.announceNone: Nothing is waiting for you now

homeNotice.title: Your home page is now Inbox
homeNotice.body: Anycon now opens on Inbox: approvals, plans, questions, device requests, sessions you flagged for follow-up and sessions that failed, all in one list across your nodes.
homeNotice.whereDesktop: The node home page (projects, temporary sessions, recent sessions) is under Node home in the node menu at the top of the sidebar.
homeNotice.wherePhone: The node home page is under More > Nodes. The menu on the left is replaced by the bar at the bottom: Inbox, Sessions and More.

dispatch.title: Let an agent handle this to-do
dispatch.projectWrittenBack: The project is saved on the to-do once it is handed over.
dispatch.noIsolation: The agent will change files directly in the project directory, with no isolation: its changes land in your working copy.
dispatch.noIsolationNoWorktree: This project cannot have a worktree, so the agent works directly in the project directory, with no isolation: its changes land in your working copy.
dispatch.noPushHint: The agent is told not to push or open pull requests, and where the agent supports it they are blocked.
dispatch.noPushUnsupported: {{agent}} cannot block pushes and pull requests. Untick this to hand it over anyway; the agent may then push and open pull requests.
dispatch.pushAllowed: The agent may push and open pull requests.
dispatch.previewNote: This is what the agent receives first, including reports from earlier rounds. If a result is recorded before you send, what is sent may differ.
dispatch.acceptsNote: An agent added this item. Handing it over accepts it.

blocked.offline: The node is offline. Handing over needs the node online; it is not queued.
blocked.noAgent: No agent is ready on this node.
blocked.noProject: Choose a project first: the agent needs somewhere to work.
blocked.gitPending: The node is still reading this project’s git state. Try again in a moment.
blocked.noPush: {{agent}} cannot block pushes and pull requests: untick “No push, no pull request” to hand it over anyway.

errors.closed: This to-do is closed. Reopen it first.
errors.tooManySessions: This to-do has already been handed over 20 times. Add a new item for what is left.
errors.noProject: This to-do has no project. Choose one.
errors.messageId: This request was already used with different settings. Close the dialog and try again.
errors.noPush: This agent cannot block pushes and pull requests. Untick “No push, no pull request” to hand it over anyway.
errors.unsupported: This node does not support handing over to-dos. Update anycon on it.
errors.forbidden: This connection is not allowed to hand over to-dos.
errors.notFound: Not found: the project or the to-do no longer exists.
errors.linkRetry: The connection failed, so it may or may not have been handed over. It is safe to try again: it will not start a second session.

history.title: History
history.truncated: Only the beginning of the report was kept.
history.state: You changed the state from {{from}} to {{to}}

reviewPage.notReady: This item is not ready to review right now: the agent is still working or it needs a decision first.
reviewPage.noResult: No report was recorded for this item.
reviewPage.noSession: The session no longer exists, so there are no changes to show.
reviewPage.denials_one: The agent’s reviewer denied {{count}} action in this session.
reviewPage.denials_other: The agent’s reviewer denied {{count}} actions in this session.
reviewPage.denialsUnknown: This browser has not opened the session, so it does not know what the agent’s reviewer denied; open the session to see it.
reviewPage.openChanges: Open the changes in the session
reviewPage.patchFailed: Could not load this file’s changes.
reviewPage.patchTruncated: The change is long; only the beginning is shown.
reviewPage.noPatchBinary: A binary or deleted file: there is no text change to show.
reviewPage.reworkSent: Sent to the agent. The item goes back to in progress.
reviewPage.reworkQueued: Queued: the agent is busy and will get it next.
reviewPage.pushAction: Commit, push and open a pull request
reviewPage.pushConfirmBody: This session was started with “no push, no pull request”. Turning that off lets the agent push the branch and open a pull request, and restarts the agent process.
reviewPage.pushConfirm: Allow it and ask the agent
reviewPage.pushSent: Asked the agent to commit, push and open a pull request.
reviewPage.pushSettingsFailed: Could not turn off “no push” for this session, so nothing was sent.
reviewPage.pushSendFailed: Could not send the message to the agent.
reviewPage.pushMessage: Commit the current changes on branch {{branch}} with a message that summarizes what changed, push the branch to the remote and open a pull request with gh pr create. Write a clear title and description.
reviewPage.pushMessageNoBranch: Commit the current changes with a message that summarizes what changed, push the branch to the remote and open a pull request with gh pr create. Write a clear title and description.
reviewPage.cleanupBody: The item is dropped. The agent worked on branch {{branch}} in its own worktree. Remove them too?

todos.capturePlaceholder: Add a to-do. The first line is the title, the rest is the note.

todos.emptyBody: Add one with the + button, or press C.
todos.pickOne: Select a to-do to see its details.
todos.cached: Showing the last known to-dos of {{nodes}} (cached). Changes you make are kept and sent when the node is back.
todos.fromSession: Open the session it came from
todos.sessionGone: The session it came from no longer exists.
todos.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be deleted from the node. This cannot be undone.
todos.bulk: Change the state of the selected to-dos
todos.checking: No longer in the open list. Checking whether it was closed or deleted elsewhere…
todos.orphansChecking_one: {{count}} to-do with unsaved edits is no longer in the open list. Checking whether it was closed or deleted…
todos.orphansChecking_other: {{count}} to-dos with unsaved edits are no longer in the open list. Checking whether they were closed or deleted…
todos.orphans_one: {{count}} unsaved edit to a to-do that was deleted elsewhere
todos.orphans_other: {{count}} unsaved edits to to-dos that were deleted elsewhere
todos.orphanTitle: This to-do no longer exists, but you had unsaved changes.

todos.rejectedToast: “{{title}}” was not saved: {{reason}} Open it to retry or discard.
todos.unknownNode: This link points to a node this browser does not know.
todos.nodeUnsupported: {{node}} does not keep a to-do list. Update its daemon to use to-dos there.
todos.outsideFilter: {{node}} is not ticked in your node filter.
todos.editedElsewhere: Changed elsewhere while you were editing: {{fields}}. Your save will not touch them.

todos.forgotUnsynced_one: {{count}} unsynced to-do change was discarded with the node.
todos.forgotUnsynced_other: {{count}} unsynced to-do changes were discarded with the node.

replay.full: The to-do list is full, so a to-do could not be reopened. It stays closed.
replay.fullKept: The to-do list is full, so a to-do could not be reopened. It stays closed; your other changes to it were kept.

todos.discardedMore_one: {{count}} later change to the same to-do was discarded with it.
todos.discardedMore_other: {{count}} later changes to the same to-do were discarded with it.

errors.rejected: The node did not accept this change.

spaces.title: Space
spaces.manageHint: A space is the set of nodes with the same group name. The group is stored on each node, so your other devices see it too.
spaces.mergeConfirm: This merges “{{from}}” into “{{to}}”: {{nodes}} will all be in “{{to}}”. Press Merge to continue.
spaces.stillOld: Still under the old name “{{old}}”: {{nodes}}. Rename them again when they are back.
spaces.renameGone: That space no longer exists (its nodes were regrouped elsewhere). Nothing was changed.
spaces.oddName: This name has invisible or control characters, unusual spacing or a non-standard encoding, so it can look the same as another name.
spaces.lookalike: “{{name}}” looks the same as the existing space “{{existing}}” but is a different name. Renaming would create a second space that looks identical.
spaces.outsideSpace: This belongs to the space “{{space}}”, which is not selected.
spaces.movedTo: “{{node}}” is now in the space “{{space}}”, which is not selected. The request may still be waiting there.
spaces.movedToNone: “{{node}}” is no longer in any space, so it is outside the current selection. The request may still be waiting there.

result.offline: Offline: not changed. Try again when it is back.

errors.too_long: The group name is too long (at most 40 characters).
errors.control: The group name must be a single line without control characters.
errors.invalid: The node did not accept this group name.
errors.envOverride: The group is set by an environment variable on that node; change it there.

move.title: Move to another node…
move.pick: Choose the node to move it to
move.noTarget: No other node that supports to-dos is available.
move.confirmSpace: “{{node}}” is in a different space ({{space}}). Move it there?
move.confirmSpaceNone: “{{node}}” is in no space. Move it there?
move.agentNote: The copy on the other node will be recorded as added by you, not by an agent.
move.agentNoteOther: The copy on the other node will be recorded as added by you, not automatically.
move.projectNote: The project is not carried over: a project name on another node is not necessarily the same project.
move.cannotClose: Moving is in progress. This window stays open until it is done.
move.sourceGone: The to-do had already been deleted on the source node in the meantime, perhaps moved by another tab or device. The copy on {{node}} exists, and a second copy may now exist there too.
move.changed: This to-do changed since you opened the dialog. Check it and move again.
move.changedGone: This to-do is no longer on its node. Nothing was copied by this move. If it was moved from another tab or device, it is on the other node now.
move.changedCopy: This to-do changed here after it was copied to {{node}}. The copy there has the old content, and nothing was deleted here. Check both.
move.changedGoneCopy: This to-do is no longer here (it was deleted elsewhere) after it was copied to {{node}}. The copy on {{node}} exists; nothing was deleted here.
move.failedAddMaybe: {{node}} did not accept it this time ({{reason}}). A copy from the earlier attempt may exist there. Nothing was deleted here.
move.deleteMaybe: The connection failed while deleting it here: it may or may not have been deleted. The copy on {{node}} exists. Check this to-do before deleting the copy.
move.copyGone: The copy on {{node}} is no longer there. Nothing was deleted here.
move.copyDeleteFailed: Could not delete the copy on {{node}}. It is still there.
move.copyDeleteMaybe: The connection to {{node}} failed while deleting the copy: it may or may not have been deleted.
move.stateFailed: Copied to {{node}}, but it is open there, not “{{state}}”. The original was not touched.
move.stateMaybe: Copied to {{node}}, but the connection failed while restoring “{{state}}”: it may or may not have been applied. The original was not touched.
move.stuck: The to-do was copied to {{node}}, but it could not be deleted here. It exists on both nodes.
move.unreadableSource: Could not read this to-do on its node to check it, so nothing was copied.
move.unreadableSourceCopy: Could not read this to-do on its node to check it. The copy on {{node}} exists; nothing was deleted here.
move.unreadableTarget: Could not read the copy on {{node}} to check it, so nothing was deleted here. Try again.
move.unexpected: Something unexpected stopped the move before anything was copied.
move.unexpectedCopy: Something unexpected stopped the move after the copy to {{node}} was made. Nothing was deleted here; check both nodes.
move.copySourceGone: The to-do here may be gone, so the copy on {{node}} could be the only one left. It was not deleted.
move.copyChanged: The copy on {{node}} was edited there, so it was not deleted.
move.noteCopy: A copy is on {{node}}; nothing was deleted here.
move.changedMaybe: This to-do changed here. A copy may exist on {{node}} from the attempt that lost its reply, with the old content; nothing was deleted here. Check {{node}} before moving it again.
move.changedGoneMaybe: This to-do is no longer here. A copy may exist on {{node}} from the attempt that lost its reply; nothing was deleted here. Check {{node}}.
move.unreadableSourceMaybe: Could not read this to-do on its node to check it. A copy may exist on {{node}}; nothing was deleted here.
move.unexpectedMaybe: Something unexpected stopped the move. A copy may exist on {{node}}; nothing was deleted here. Check both nodes.
move.copyEdited: The copy on {{node}} was changed there, so its state was left alone. Nothing was deleted here.
move.failedAdd: Could not move it: {{node}} did not accept it ({{reason}}). Nothing changed.
move.failedLink: The connection to {{node}} failed while copying: it may or may not have been copied there. Nothing was deleted here. Resuming in this window reuses the same copy; after a reload, or after choosing to leave both, check that node first.

blocked.syncingSource: This node is still syncing after reconnecting. Try again in a moment.
blocked.syncingTarget: {{node}} is still syncing after reconnecting. Try again in a moment.
blocked.copyDeleting: The copy on the other node is being deleted. Wait for it to finish.
blocked.offlineSource: This node is offline, so the to-do cannot be moved now.
blocked.offlineTarget: {{node}} is offline, so the to-do cannot be moved there now.
blocked.queued: This to-do has changes that are not sent yet. Wait until they are synced, then try again.
blocked.unreviewed: This to-do was added automatically (for example by an agent) and you have not accepted it. Accept it first (a moved copy would be recorded as added by you).
blocked.draft: You have unsaved edits to this to-do. Save or discard them first.

toast.followUp: {{title}} finished and is waiting for you.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.minChars: Type at least 2 characters to search conversations.

setup.installBody: The daemon runs on the machine that has your coding agents. Run these commands there.
setup.doneBody: Your node is paired. Open it to create a project and start a session.
setup.installSourceHint: no prebuilt binary for this platform, build from source (needs Rust)
setup.passwordBody: With a node password you can unlock this node from any device, even when none of your paired devices is at hand. It is optional, and you can set it later in the node settings.
setup.notifyBody: Anycon can tell you when a session needs your approval, hits an error or finishes, even when this tab is closed. It is optional, and you can change it later in Settings → Notifications.

pair.title: Pair a node
pair.subtitle: Enter the code shown by anycon pair on the machine you want to control.
pair.codeHint: 8 characters, e.g. 7K3P-Q2MX (16 characters for a link or QR code). Dashes and case do not matter.

errors.retry: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it and try again.
errors.invalid_code: A pairing code has 8 or 16 letters and digits.
errors.not_found: That code does not exist or has expired. Run anycon pair again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.quota: Your account has reached a limit on devices, nodes or daily pairing attempts. Remove devices you no longer use under Account settings → Devices, or check which limit is full.
errors.forbidden: That node belongs to a different account.
errors.hub_unavailable: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection.
errors.no_identity: The hub did not accept this browser as a device.
errors.timeout: The node did not answer in time. Check that its daemon is running.
errors.peer_gone: The node disconnected during pairing. Try again.
errors.handshake_failed: The secure handshake failed. Check the code and try again.
errors.ack_invalid: The node could not prove its identity, so nothing was saved. Run anycon pair again and make sure you are using the right hub.
errors.key_changed: This node’s key has changed. Remove it in settings first, then pair again.

link.warning: You opened a pairing link. Pairing adds that node to your account and lets this browser control it. Only continue if you started pairing yourself, on your own machine.

node.noProjectsHint: Create a project, clone a repository or open an existing folder, or just send a message to start a temporary session.
node.cachedHint: Showing cached data while the node is offline
node.unknownBody: This node is not paired with this browser, or it was revoked.
node.versionBody: The node speaks protocol {{daemon}} but this web app speaks {{web}}. Update the daemon or reload the page.
node.noiseFailedTitle: This node no longer recognizes this device
node.noiseFailedBody: It may have been reinstalled, or this browser was revoked. Unlock it again with your account, or pair again with a short code.
node.projectsOffline: The project list is not available while the node is offline.
node.removedTitle: This node was removed from your account
node.removedBody: The hub no longer knows this node: it was removed or revoked on another device. Forgetting it deletes its pairing and cached sessions from this browser. Nothing on the node's machine is deleted.

project.name: Name
project.trashBody: The folder moves to the node's trash. You can restore it from node settings.
project.noSessionsHint: Use “New session” to start the first one.
project.nodeOffline: This node is offline. Projects can only be added while it is online.
project.nodeNoWorkspace: This node does not manage a workspace, so projects cannot be added to it.
project.locationHint: Which of the node's workspace folders the project is created in.
project.rootUnavailableHint: This folder is not available on the node (is the disk mounted?). Pick another location, or restart the node after fixing it.
project.linkedHint: A linked project lives in its own folder on the node, outside the workspace.
project.missingBody: {{path}} no longer exists or cannot be read, so new sessions are turned off. Restore the folder, or remove this project from the list.
project.removeBody: This only removes the project from anycon. The folder and the files in it are not deleted.
project.removeSessions: Existing sessions stay in your history. If you link this same folder again they can continue; if this name later points to a different folder, the old sessions cannot continue.
project.nameExists: A project with this name already exists.
project.nameInvalid: A project name cannot be empty, contain “/”, “\” or control characters, or start with a dot.
project.nameTooLong: That name is too long (255 bytes at most).

linkErrors.forbidden: This node does not allow linking that folder. It must be inside the allowed folders (workspace.link_roots), must not be hidden (unless it is listed there explicitly) or a system or credentials folder, and cannot contain or sit inside anycon’s own workspace or data folders.
linkErrors.exists: That name is already used by another project, or this folder is already linked. Pick a different name.
linkErrors.invalid: That folder cannot be linked. It may already be part of the workspace, or the name is not valid.

removeErrors.busy: This project has running sessions. Wait for them to finish or stop them, then try again.
removeErrors.invalid: Only linked projects can be removed from the list.

project.nameCase: Another project is named “{{name}}”. On a case-insensitive filesystem (the default on macOS and Windows) the node counts that as the same name and will refuse it.
project.nameCaseClash: Another project is named “{{name}}”. Names that differ only in case count as the same name on this node.

files.openWorkdir: Browse the files in the working directory
files.chooseProject: Choose a project to browse its files
files.noProjects: This node has no projects yet.
files.missingProject: The folder of this project is missing.
files.name: Name

files.noHighlight: Syntax highlighting is off for large files.
files.imageTooLarge: This image is too large to preview ({{size}}). The limit is {{limit}}.
files.imageFailed: This image could not be displayed.
files.offlineBody: Files are read from the node when you open them. They will load again when it is back online.

errors.not_found: This path does not exist on the node. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.forbidden: The node does not allow access to this path.
errors.invalid: This path is not a regular file or folder.
errors.image_unsupported: The node is too old to send images. Update the anycon daemon on it.
errors.bad_data: The node sent data that could not be read.

folderPicker.label: Choose a folder

folderPicker.truncated: Only the first 1000 folders are shown. Type a path to go further.

nodeSettings.agentsHint: Agents found on the node. Defaults here apply to new sessions from every device.
nodeSettings.defaultsHint: Stored on the node and shared by all your devices.

nodeSettings.wsRootUnavailableHint: This folder is missing on the node (is the disk mounted?), so its projects are not listed. Restart the node after fixing it.

limits.hint: Settings you can change from here. They take effect right away; the node does not restart. Everything else, such as agent commands, folders and the hub address, can only be changed on the machine itself.

limits.notSaved: Nothing was saved. Fix the marked setting and try again.

group.label: Group
group.hint: A name such as “Home” or “Work”. Nodes with the same group are shown together. Up to 40 characters; leave empty for no group.

max_concurrent.label: Concurrent sessions
max_concurrent.hint: How many sessions can run a turn at the same time. The others wait in a queue.

idle_timeout.label: Idle timeout
idle_timeout.hint: How long an idle agent process stays alive before it exits. The session can still be continued. 0 keeps it running.

allow_dangerous_modes.label: Allow dangerous permission modes
allow_dangerous_modes.hint: Modes such as bypass permissions or full access, where the agent acts without asking.

request_timeout.label: Approval timeout
request_timeout.hint: A permission request nobody answers is denied after this long. 0 means never.

default.label: Where new sessions start
default.hint: In git projects: in a worktree of their own, or directly in the project folder. This only sets the initial choice.

branch_prefix.label: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.hint: New worktree branches are named prefix/name. Letters, digits, . _ and -, up to 40 characters; leave empty for no prefix.

auto_archive_on_pr_close.label: Archive when the pull request closes
auto_archive_on_pr_close.hint: Archive a session when the pull request of its branch is merged or closed. Needs gh installed and signed in on the node.

enabled.label: Dev server preview
enabled.hint: Lets your devices open the web apps running on that machine. Turning it off closes every open preview.

ticket_ttl.label: Preview link lifetime
ticket_ttl.hint: How long a preview link stays valid.

session_idle_after.label: Remind about unread results after
session_idle_after.hint: A session that stays idle this long without anyone looking at it triggers a reminder.

level.label: Log level
level.hint: How much the node writes to its log. You can read the log under About, View logs.

errors.rangeInt: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.rangeDuration: Enter a duration between {{min}} and {{max}}, like 20m.

errors.notEditable: This setting cannot be changed from here.

logs.title: Node logs
logs.hint: The end of the node's log file. Lines that could contain conversation text are left out.
logs.empty: No log lines at this level.

nodeSettings.removeHint: For a machine that was reinstalled or is no longer used. Removes the node from your account and forgets it on this browser. Works while the node is offline.
nodeSettings.removeConfirmBody: The hub stops routing to this node and drops all of its pairings; this browser forgets it. Projects and session history on that machine are not deleted. To use it again, run `anycon init --force` on it and pair again.
nodeSettings.removeFailed: Could not remove the node: {{error}}. Nothing was changed; try again.
nodeSettings.longCodeHint: Safer when you pair through a hub you do not run. Turn it off for a short code that is easier to type.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeBody: Make a one-time code. A new device that signs in to the same account can use it to join this node.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeHow: On the new device, sign in to the same account, pick this node and choose “I have an access code”.
nodeSettings.enrollCodeDisabled: Approving new devices is turned off for this node. Turn it on in the Access tab.

devices.revokeBody: The device loses access immediately and has to pair again.
devices.revokeNodeBody: The hub stops routing to this node and drops all of its pairings; this browser forgets it. Projects and session history on that machine are not deleted. To use it again, run `anycon init --force` on it and pair again.
devices.revokeSelf: This is the browser you are using. You will have to pair it again.
devices.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the device: {{error}}. It may still be able to connect — try again.
devices.revokedOffline: {{count}} node(s) were offline and still hold this device’s key. The hub no longer routes to it; remove it from their device list once they are back.

settings.tokensHint: Tokens sign you in from a new browser. Each token is shown once when you create it.
settings.tokenOnce: Copy it now. You will not be able to see it again.
settings.lastMethod: The last sign-in method cannot be removed.
settings.sessionsHint: Browsers currently signed in to your account.
settings.devicesHint: Every device on your account, grouped by the node it is paired with.

settings.emailSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
settings.emailResendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
settings.emailLinked: Email linked. You can now sign in with it on any device.
settings.emailUnlinkBody: You will no longer be able to sign in with this email, and email alerts stop.

settings.loginEmailOnly: This hub signs you in by email. You can change your email in

settings.identityLinkedToast: {{provider}} linked. You can now sign in with it.
settings.identityLastMethod: {{provider}} is your only way to sign in, so it can’t be unlinked. Add another sign-in method first.
settings.deleteAccountHint: Permanently removes your account and its devices from this hub.

settings.deleteAccountHistory: Session history lives on your nodes and is not deleted.
settings.deleteAccountRepair: To use a node with another account or hub, you will have to pair it again.

settings.deleteAccountReauth: For your security, deleting an account needs a recent sign-in (within the last 10 minutes). Sign in again, then come back to finish.

agentError.agent_reconnecting: Connection to the model dropped — reconnecting…
agentError.unsupported_request: The agent asked for something anycon does not support yet, so the request was declined.
agentError.context_window_exceeded: The conversation no longer fits in the model’s context window. Start a new session, or send something shorter.
agentError.sandbox_error: The sandbox stopped or failed a command. Check the session’s permission mode; a less restrictive one may be needed.
agentError.policy_violation: The provider’s usage policy stopped this request. Rephrase it or change the task.
agentError.usage_limit: The usage or credit limit has been reached. Check your plan and billing details, or wait for the limit window to reset.
agentError.usage_limit_resets: The usage limit has been reached. It resets {{time}}.
agentError.rate_limited: The agent hit a rate or usage limit. Wait a while and try again.
agentError.overloaded: The model provider is out of capacity right now. This is not about your own usage — try again in a few minutes, or pick another model in the session settings.
agentError.budget_exceeded: This session’s token budget is used up. Adjust the budget in the agent’s own configuration (for Codex, its config), or start a new session, then send again.
agentError.limitScopeModel: This limit applies to one model only. Pick another model in the session settings to keep going.
agentError.auth_failed: The agent is not signed in, or its credentials were rejected. Check its status in the node settings.
agentError.agent_context_reset: Earlier messages in this conversation are no longer visible to the agent — it started a fresh thread.
agentError.attachment_failed: The node couldn't save the attachments in the session's working directory, so this message was not passed to the agent. Fix the cause below (for example free up disk space), then send it again.
agentError.agent_config: The agent’s own configuration no longer matches this conversation. Do what the message below says (for Codex, switch back to the model provider the conversation was created with), then send again.
agentError.model_not_found: The provider says this model does not exist or is not available to you. Pick another model in the session settings.

markdown.imageHint: Remote images can leak information to their host, so they only load when you click - and the hub’s security policy may block them anyway.
markdown.openImage: This image is from an external site and the hub’s security policy does not load it. Open it from {{host}}

removeDevice.title: Sign out and remove this device
removeDevice.body: This revokes this browser on every node that is online right now, signs you out, and deletes the device key, token and cached sessions stored in this browser. Nodes that are offline keep this browser’s key until you remove it from their device list, but the hub will no longer route to it.
removeDevice.errorHub: The hub did not revoke this device: {{error}}. Nothing was deleted. Try again, or remove the local data anyway (the device will stay registered on the hub until you revoke it from another browser).
removeDevice.errorLogout: Signing out failed: {{error}}. Nothing was deleted.
removeDevice.reportSkipped: {{count}} node(s) were offline, so they still hold this browser’s key. The hub no longer routes to it; remove it from their device list when they are back.
removeDevice.errorNodes: These nodes could not revoke this browser: {{nodes}}. Nothing else was changed and nothing was deleted, so you can try again when they are online. If you remove the local data anyway, those nodes keep this browser’s key until you remove it from their device list.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: This ends your session with the hub, but this browser keeps its device key, token and cached sessions on this computer: signing in again here is the same device, and anyone who can open this browser’s developer tools could still use them. Push notifications for this browser are turned off (turn them on again in notification settings after you sign back in). On a shared or borrowed computer, remove the device instead.

shortcut.reviewFirst: That request was off screen. Check it, then press the shortcut again.

workspace.label: Work in
workspace.branchInvalid: That is not a valid git branch name.
workspace.branchReserved: main, master and HEAD can’t be used as the new branch name.
workspace.notReady: Worktrees need the project folder to be the root of a git repository with at least one commit.
workspace.readingBlocked: Waiting for the project’s git info before creating the session…

worktree.title: Worktrees
worktree.hint: Worktrees anycon created for sessions, including ones kept after archiving and ones whose session was deleted.
worktree.removeBody: The worktree folder inside project {{project}} is deleted from the node.
worktree.discardHint: Uncommitted changes exist nowhere else and can’t be recovered.
worktree.archiveBody: This session works in a worktree on branch {{branch}}. Choose what happens to the worktree.

dispose.label: What to do with the worktree
dispose.autoHint: Deletes the worktree if it has no uncommitted changes (the branch is kept if it has commits of its own). Keeps it otherwise.
dispose.keepHint: The folder and the branch stay. Delete them later in node settings.
dispose.removeHint: The folder is deleted. The branch stays unless you delete it too.
dispose.branchKept: The branch stays while the worktree is kept.
dispose.commitsLost_one: {{count}} commit on this branch would be lost
dispose.commitsLost_other: {{count}} commits on this branch would be lost
dispose.autoKeeps_one: {{count}} uncommitted change, so it will be kept.
dispose.autoKeeps_other: {{count}} uncommitted changes, so it will be kept.

preview.stopBody: This disconnects the preview of this port on all your devices. Pages open elsewhere stop loading. You can start it again at any time.
preview.stoppedBody: The preview of port {{port}} was closed on every device.
preview.emptyBody: When the agent starts a dev server, its port shows up here. You can also pick “Other port…” and enter one yourself.
preview.detectionUnavailable: This machine can’t detect listening ports, so only ports listed in preview.allow_ports can be previewed.
preview.offline: The node is offline. Ports and new previews are unavailable until it is back.

errors.port_not_allowed: This port isn’t allowed for preview. By default only servers started by this session are. To preview another port, add it to preview.allow_ports in the node’s config.toml.
errors.disabled: Preview is turned off on this node (preview.enabled in config.toml).
errors.unauthorized: The hub doesn’t accept this browser as a paired device. Sign in again or pair this browser with the node.

local.no_device_token: This browser has no device token for the hub yet. Pair it with a node first.
local.no_node_key: This browser doesn’t have the node’s key. Pair it with the node again.
local.bad_template: The hub’s preview address is not valid.
local.bad_label: The node returned a preview name the hub can’t use.

hub.preview_disabled: This hub has preview turned off.
hub.invalid_label: The node returned a preview name the hub can’t use.
hub.label_taken: This preview address is already used by another node on this hub.
hub.too_many_labels: This node already has the maximum number of preview addresses on this hub.
hub.not_found: The hub doesn’t know this node, or this browser isn’t paired with it.

list.title: Open previews
list.hint: Preview tickets issued by this node’s devices and still valid. Closing one revokes every ticket of that port and disconnects it.

policy.title: Which ports can be previewed
policy.default: By default a preview can only reach servers started by the session itself: the listening process runs under the session’s agent, or was started in its working folder.
policy.allowPorts: To allow other ports, list them in preview.allow_ports in the node’s config.toml. Set preview.enabled = false to turn previews off for the whole node. The node only ever connects to 127.0.0.1 and ::1.

git.stale: Could not refresh. Showing the last known state.

tab.failed: The worktree could not be created, so there is nothing to compare.
tab.removed: The worktree was deleted when the session was archived. Unarchive the session to rebuild it from branch {{branch}}.

scan.title: Scan to approve a new device
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code shown on the new device.
scan.notAnycon: That is not an anycon enrollment QR code.
scan.unpaired: This browser is not paired with the node {{node}}, so it cannot approve.
scan.offline: The node cannot be reached right now. Try again when it is online.
scan.onlyIfInFront: Only approve if this QR code is on the screen of the device right in front of you.
scan.missing: This request is no longer there. It may have expired: ask the new device for a fresh QR code.
scan.notScan: This QR code belongs to a different kind of request, not a scan request. It cannot be approved here. Ask the new device to start again.
scan.notWaiting: This request is not waiting to be approved right now. It may already be handled, or the new device is not ready. Ask the new device for a fresh QR code.
scan.done: Approved. The new device will finish by itself.
scan.taken: Another device already handled this request.
scan.gone: This request has expired or was cancelled.
scan.deniedHelp: Allow camera access for this site in your browser settings and try again. Or let the new device use “Approve on a paired device” instead.
scan.unavailable: The camera could not be started on this device.

approve.unverified: reported by the device, not verified
approve.onlyThisOne: Only approve the device right in front of you.
approve.ifNotYou: If you did not just start this on another device, tap Deny.
approve.scanOnly: This device asked to be approved by scanning its QR code. Use “Scan to approve a new device”, or deny it.
approve.codeIntro: Type this code on the new device to finish joining {{node}}.
approve.codeWarning: Do not tell it to anyone. anycon will never ask you for it.
approve.taken: Another device already handled this request.

enrollTab.intro: Decide how new devices can join this node. Devices that are already paired are not affected by anything here.
enrollTab.loadFailed: Could not read the access settings from the node.
enrollTab.passwordUnset: No password yet. Set one to unlock this node from any device, even without a paired device at hand.
enrollTab.passwordHint: A new device can unlock this node by typing the password. The node checks it itself and limits wrong guesses; the hub never sees it.
enrollTab.backoff: Too many wrong attempts. The next try is allowed in {{time}}.
enrollTab.lockedBody: Password unlock is locked after 10 wrong attempts in a row. Run anycon passwd --enable on the node, or turn it back on here.
enrollTab.reenableBody: 10 wrong attempts in a row may mean someone is guessing. Only continue if you typed it wrong yourself. If you are not sure, change the password first.
enrollTab.setBody: Anyone who knows this password can add a device to this node if they are signed in to your account. The node never stores the password itself.
enrollTab.passwordRule: At least {{count}} characters. There are no other rules: the node limits wrong guesses itself.
enrollTab.clearBody: Devices that are already paired keep working. New devices will have to use a paired device to join.
enrollTab.approvalLabel: Allow approving from a paired device
enrollTab.approvalHint: Lets new devices join by QR scan or with an access code. Turn it off to allow only the node password.
enrollTab.activityFailed: Could not read the node’s activity log.

errors.codeExhausted: This code is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired or has been used up. Request a new one.
errors.wrongScan: The approval did not match. Start over to get a new QR code.
errors.backoff: Too many attempts. Try again in {{time}}.
errors.locked: Password unlock for this node is locked after 10 wrong attempts in a row. Run this on the node itself, or turn it back on from a paired device (node settings, Access):
errors.method_disabled: This node does not allow this way of unlocking. Try another one.
errors.password_not_set: This node has no password. Pick another way, or set one from a paired device.
errors.no_code: This node has no valid access code right now. Make one with “Add device” on a paired device.
errors.offline: The node is offline. Unlocking needs it to be online.
errors.busy: This node is handling too many enrollments right now. Try again in a minute.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.quota: Your account has reached a limit on devices, nodes or daily pairing attempts. Remove devices you no longer use under Account settings → Devices, or check which limit is full.
errors.forbidden: This browser is not allowed to unlock that node.
errors.not_found: That node is not on your account.
errors.hub_unavailable: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection.
errors.hub_no_reply: No answer from the hub. You may be sending requests too often. Wait a little and try again.
errors.handshake_failed: The secure handshake failed. Start over.
errors.no_identity: The hub did not accept this browser as a device.
errors.ack_invalid: The node could not prove its identity, so nothing was saved. Make sure you are using the right hub.
errors.key_changed: This node’s key has changed. Forget it here first, then unlock again.
errors.invalid: The node did not accept that request.
